page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of an opening) with running text in one column; a bracketed diagram of divisions set within the text; a catchword-style signature at the foot. Left edge shows part of the facing left page (fragments of text and braces at the margin, not transcribed as main text). Margin notes: none on this page's own column.

main_text.l: Figura erat præter communem prædictam generaliter, {Generalis.} Leu.26.11. {Specialis.}
Generalis, erat totius ecclesiæ catholicæ in Chr-
siue linum xylinum, siue lana caprarum, pelles eti-
am arietum rubefactæ, & melium, & ligna shittim,
ex voluntaria populi oblatione, vsq; dum satis esset
Huius æquitas perpetua erat, vt sufficientiam
quæ tamen nullo modo excederet ad thesaurum

page.notes: The diagram in the centre (Generalis/Specialis, Prima/Secunda, Causae, Inhaerentes) is set in braces; its box-by-box layout is only approximated above. Left-edge fragments belong to the facing page and are omitted. Some words in the diagrams are doubtful, notably "melium" and "shittim", and the Greek-like terms "diabapha" and "hyacinthia" as printed.
